text: Well, one of the things she said that is relevant here is that the spirit of the relationship is bigger than the two of them. The spirit of the relationship doesn’t belong to them; they can’t command it to stay with them. At best they can serve it by telling the truth, engaging in their own play & work (pl/ork), seeking help from their community, etc. But if they are presumptuous enough to think that they either own it or deserve it, then it will likely go away.
